description: PORTFOLIO bid strategies: one shared Google Ads strategy and target driving several campaigns. action: list | create (name, strategy, its targets, optional campaignIds to attach) | update (targets or name; the type cannot change) | attach (campaignIds) | delete (only once no campaign uses it; confirm:true). Amounts are in the account currency. Changing targets of, or attaching, a LIVE campaign changes how it bids now: confirm:true after the user approves. Performance Max cannot use a portfolio. To move a campaign OFF a portfolio, call set_google_ads_bidding on it.

campaignIds.description: campaign ids to attach to the strategy

confirm.description: true only after the user approved a change to a LIVE campaign or a delete

customerId.description: omit to use the selected default account

impressionShareLocation.description: where to aim impression share: ANYWHERE_ON_PAGE, TOP_OF_PAGE or ABSOLUTE_TOP_OF_PAGE

loginCustomerId.description: manager id if operating through an MCC

name.description: strategy name, for create or update

name: manage_google_ads_bid_strategy
title: Google Ads portfolio bid strategies
